Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE measures Treasury volatility and term-premium stress: below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress. At 101.82, conditions are moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding; the 3.90% effective rate is not, by itself, evidence of a funding dislocation. NFCI measures broad financial conditions; negative values indicate looser conditions (-0.56). 10Y Treasury yields reflect duration and term-premium repricing, not overnight funding.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • Sep 30 is quarter-end and U.S. federal fiscal year-end; watch rebalancing, Treasury settlement, and funding sensitivity. NY Fed Treasury operations for Sep 15-Oct 14 indicate about $15.6B in reinvestment purchases and no reserve-management purchases.
  • Wednesday Sep 30 has a concentrated 8:30 AM ET release cluster: PCE/income/spending, GDP third estimate and related state data, Census advance indicators, and Chicago Fed NFCI. Friday Oct 2 payrolls is the largest scheduled labor catalyst.
  • The White House Sep 27 U.S.-China Board of Trade statement describes recommended product lists for reduced tariff treatment, subject to domestic processes; monitor implementation headlines, with no timed catalyst verified.
  • NYSE lists Sep 30 as quarter-end and quarterly options expiration; Cboe weekly expiries run through Oct 2. No U.S. market holiday or shortened session appears Sep 29-Oct 6. CME quarterly roll/expiry dates have passed.
  • No FOMC decision or minutes falls within Sep 29-Oct 6; minutes are scheduled Oct 7 at 2:00 PM ET, just beyond this horizon. Treasury estimates Q3 borrowing at $739B and Q4 at $628B; enhanced long-end buyback sizes apply through Nov 4.
Omissions and Watch
  • BLS direct schedule request returned HTTP 403. The current official 2026 BLS schedule was inspected through the official web page fallback; Sep 29 JOLTS, Sep 30 metro employment, and Oct 2 Employment Situation are included. No CPI or PPI release is scheduled within Sep 29-Oct 6.
  • TreasuryDirect gives exact Sep 29 six-week and 52-week bill bid cutoffs. Future bill auctions for Sep 30, Oct 1, Oct 5 and Oct 6 and the Oct 6 three-year note have no auction-specific exact bid cutoffs posted; omitted from timed rows.
  • EIA's current official petroleum status page does not expose a verified next-release date/time; the stale listed date conflicts with the requested current horizon, so the weekly petroleum report is omitted rather than inferred. The Oct 1 natural-gas storage report is included from EIA's explicit next-release date. Petroleum Supply Monthly is dated Sep 30, but no exact ET time was verified, so omitted from timed rows.
  • No NAR housing release falls in the Sep 29-Oct 6 horizon on the official schedule. Chicago Fed, ADP, ISM, and Conference Board items are from their own date-specific publisher calendars. The market snapshot uses one delayed Yahoo Finance feed; cash closes and overnight quotes are labeled separately.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Treat the 8:30 AM Wednesday data cluster, quarter-end flows, and Friday payrolls as successive volatility catalysts. With MOVE in the moderate band and Treasury yields higher, wait for ES reaction and cross-market confirmation; no directional surprise is assumed.
INVALIDATION
Invalidate a range/continuation thesis if ES breaks and holds beyond the overnight range with confirmation from Treasury yields and volatility, or data materially reprices the policy path. Scenario framework only, not a trade signal.
